notes: Each worker is an isolated ComfyUI process bound to one GPU. ComfyUI stays the execution engine.
Workers listen on worker_host (default loopback) and are reached only through the Studio; the Studio reverse-proxies each worker's frontend under /canvas/<worker-id>/.
safe_concurrent_runs caps how many Runs execute at the same time; extra Runs wait in the Studio queue instead of being rejected.
The cap of 2 comes from a 2-worker measurement on a 251 GiB host (about 41 GiB host RAM per running worker). Raise it only after measuring 3/4/5 concurrent Runs on the target host.
